slides.title: Java Tutorial for Beginners 2
slides.subtitle: Your First Java Program: Hello World
slides.line3: Compile with javac, run with java

slides.heading: Hello World, line by line
bullets: The class name must match the file name: HelloWorld.java
main is the entry point. Java starts running here
System.out.println prints text and moves to a new line

slides.heading: Step 1: Compile, then run
bullets: javac creates HelloWorld.class from your source file
java runs it. Do not add .class at the end

slides.heading: JDK, JRE and JVM
bullets: JRE: the JVM plus the standard libraries
JDK: the JRE plus development tools such as javac
As a developer, you install the JDK

slides.heading: Common mistakes
bullets: 1. Mismatched names: HelloWorld must be saved as HelloWorld.java
2. A missing semicolon at the end of a statement
3. Capital letters matter: System is correct, system is not

slides.heading: Recap
bullets: Every Java program starts at main
The JDK contains the JRE, which contains the JVM

steps: Click the bell for every new lesson
